name: osm2pgsql
summary: Imports OpenStreetMap data into a PostgreSQL database with PostGIS (osm2pgsql and osm2pgsql-expire), with Lua styles, built with zig on PROJ and libpq
license: GPL-2.0-or-later AND MIT AND BSL-1.0 AND bzip2-1.0.6 AND blessing AND Zlib AND PostgreSQL AND Apache-2.0

modules.name: bzip2
build: for f in blocksort huffman crctable randtable compress decompress bzlib; do cc -O2 -s -c "$f.c" -o "$f.o" || exit 1; done
ar rcs "$PREFIX/lib/libbz2.a" blocksort.o huffman.o crctable.o randtable.o compress.o decompress.o bzlib.o

modules.name: lua
build: cd src && for f in *.c; do case $f in lua.c|luac.c) ;; *) cc -O2 -s -c "$f" -o "${f%.c}.o" || exit 1 ;; esac; done
cd src && ar rcs "$PREFIX/lib/liblua.a" *.o && cp lua.h luaconf.h lualib.h lauxlib.h lua.hpp "$PREFIX/include/"
sed -n '/Copyright (C) 1994/,/\*\//p' src/lua.h > "$PREFIX/licenses/lua.txt" && grep -q 'MIT\|Permission is hereby granted' "$PREFIX/licenses/lua.txt"

modules.name: boost
build: tar xJf boost.tar.xz boost-1.92.0/boost boost-1.92.0/LICENSE_1_0.txt && mv boost-1.92.0/boost "$PREFIX/include/" && test -f "$PREFIX/include/boost/geometry.hpp"

modules.name: osm2pgsql
build: g=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(command -v gdalinfo)")") && sdk=$(dirname "$(pg_config --bindir)") && LDFLAGS="-s -Wl,-Brepro -L$g/lib" cmake -S . -B out -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=B:/prefix "-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=B:/prefix;$g;$sdk" "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_INIT=-fmacro-prefix-map=$sdk=pgsdk -fmacro-prefix-map=$g=gdalsdk" "-DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_LIBRARIES=-lsqlite3 -lshell32 -lole32" -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF -DWITH_LUAJIT=OFF > configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -80 configure.log; exit 1; }
cmake --install out > install.log 2>&1 || { tail -40 install.log; exit 1; }

g=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(command -v gdalinfo)")") && sdk=$(dirname "$(pg_config --bindir)") && cp "$sdk/bin/libpq.dll" B:/prefix/bin/ && cp -r "$g/share/proj" B:/prefix/share/ && cp -r flex-config B:/prefix/share/osm2pgsql/ && cp COPYING "$PREFIX/licenses/osm2pgsql.txt" && cp "$g/licenses/proj.txt" "$g/licenses/expat.txt" "$PREFIX/licenses/" && cp "$sdk/COPYRIGHT" "$PREFIX/licenses/postgresql.txt" && cp "$sdk/LICENSE.openssl" "$PREFIX/licenses/openssl.txt" && cp "$sdk/LICENSE.zlib" "$PREFIX/licenses/zlib.txt"
